skill.name: codex-review
skill.description: Professional code review workflow with CHANGELOG guidance for Codex, Claude, and Claude Code users.
skill.summary: Review code changes and maintain CHANGELOG entries with a Codex-guided workflow.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static findings were reviewed in context. The flagged shell execution markers are Markdown code fences around an installation command, and the hardcoded URL is a GitHub documentation link. No semantic security issues or prompt injection attempts were found.

finding_verdicts.reason: The finding points to a Markdown bash code fence for an installation example, not executable Ruby or shell code in the skill. It does not run commands or process user input.
The line is the closing Markdown code fence after an npx installation command. It is documentation text, not code executed by the skill.
The URL is a GitHub repository reference in the examples section. It does not perform a network request or send local data.

content.value_statement: Code reviews can miss regressions, risky refactors, and release notes. This skill guides Codex, Claude, and Claude Code through review and CHANGELOG workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides professional code review before commits.
Documents installation through the skills command.
Provides natural language and slash command usage hints.
limitations: Requires Codex CLI and the skills manager to be installed.
Does not include executable review scripts in this package.
Review quality depends on available project context.
Examples and troubleshooting point to an external repository.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit Review
use_cases.description: Run a structured review before committing changes to catch defects and missing release notes.

use_cases.title: Refactor Validation
use_cases.description: Check broad refactoring work for behavior changes, incomplete updates, and documentation gaps.

use_cases.title: Release Note Preparation
use_cases.description: Review changes and prepare CHANGELOG entries that match the project workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use codex-review to review my current changes before I commit them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change set

prompt_templates.title: Review With Changelog
prompt_templates.prompt: Use codex-review to review my changes and suggest the needed CHANGELOG update.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing a commit with release notes

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use codex-review to inspect this refactor for behavior changes, missed call sites, and test gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a larger refactor

prompt_templates.title: Maintainer Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use codex-review to perform a maintainer-level review of this branch, including risk, tests, and CHANGELOG impact.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before merging or release

output_examples.input: Review my staged changes before commit.
output_examples.output: A prioritized review with defects, risks, missing tests, and a short commit readiness summary.

output_examples.input: Review this refactor and update release notes.
output_examples.output: A refactor-focused review with behavior risks and a CHANGELOG entry recommendation.
A maintainer review covering merge risk, validation status, and release note completeness.

best_practices: Keep CHANGELOG.md in the project root.
Use conventional commit messages for clearer change summaries.
Provide the full diff and relevant tests for better review quality.
anti_patterns: Running review with incomplete or hidden diffs.
Accepting CHANGELOG suggestions without checking project release rules.
Using the skill as a replacement for required human approval.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps review code changes and prepare CHANGELOG updates before commits, merges, or releases.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run code automatically?
faq.answer: The skill file only documents usage. It does not include executable scripts in this package.

faq.question: Can it review large refactors?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill specifically lists large-scale refactoring review as a supported use case.

faq.question: Does it generate a final CHANGELOG file?
faq.answer: It guides CHANGELOG generation, but users should verify the final entry against project standards.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the relevant diff, test results, project conventions, and release note expectations.
